target.metric: equal-zone mean hourly absolute price error
target.coverage: All complete observed zones; preserve missing areas and report every zone, negative hours and extremes
target.scope: Full-year price-calibrated reconstruction; independent forecasts are separate

priorities.work: Reconcile low-cost supply and reporting coverage
priorities.details: Check dated wind/solar capacity, fleet geography and weather conversion against independent capacity/site sources; reconcile national Ember and A75 gross/net/embedded scope. Investigate German biomass and coal/lignite taxonomy/operational assumptions. Never scale available MW to observed generation.
priorities.evidence: Source subtype reconciliation and PVGIS-vs-atlite loss sensitivity tested with frozen coefficients; separate wind/PV negative bid controls also evaluated. Source weather/site/orientation and reporting coverage remain open; no baseline promotion.

priorities.details: Collect source-backed gas-hub, coal and EU/UK carbon inputs with delivery dates, currency and HHV/LHV basis; daily Brent is an oil proxy, not gas. First change inputs with accepted bid coefficients frozen. Report separate gas, carbon, oil and combined full-year cases; no assumed improvement or baseline promotion.
Audit French/Swedish nuclear and thermal outages/deratings from independent dated fleet or outage records, not dispatch-derived availability. Preserve capacities and all hours; record incompleteness.
priorities.evidence: RTE national daily nuclear availability is tested for France with annual-mean and two explicit daily-date mappings. This is a daily national proxy, not verified hourly plant outages; other fleets remain unchanged. No generation-derived availability or automatic promotion.

priorities.work: Resource bid shapes and negative-price behaviour
priorities.details: Investigate resource-specific variable costs, simple operating/CHP conditions and bounded low/negative renewable offers; compare mix and daily price shape. Current zero renewable bids and clipped thermal bids miss many negative-price episodes. Nordic excess negative prices need fixed-injection/geography/constraint diagnosis, not a universal negative-bid fix. No hydro-flexibility restart.

experiment_policy: Input-only source controls retain frozen accepted bids and physics for attribution. The user-authorized joint inverse trial separately allows predeclared bounded effective AC ratings and source-wind availability with two frozen bid anchors; preserve topology/PTDF/static GSK/HVDC/demand/fixed hydro and source chronology. Every case requires full-year and independent changed-source/component-physics/quantity/price replay. No automatic baseline promotion or investment certification.

sources.name: Ember European electricity prices and costs
sources.verified: Methodology describes daily national gas-hub settlement prices, API2 coal and EU/UK ETS front-December contracts. Embedded fuel-cost chart says data unavailable for download due to licensing; no series adopted.

sources.name: MIBGAS
sources.verified: Daily PVB/VTP last-price indices incorporated in controlled ES/PT gas trials. EU Regulation 2017/459 gas-day convention (05:00 UTC winter / 04:00 summer) independently replayed, including DST. Other gas remains monthly TTF; inherited heating-basis multiplier=1.0 remains a limitation, not a newly audited plant HHV/LHV correction.

sources.name: EIA daily Brent
sources.verified: EIA daily Brent and daily ECB FX incorporated in controlled oil trials across modeled oil offers; latest same-or-earlier observations carried over nontrading days (max5 days), first24 hours retain monthly benchmark. Crude proxy and inherited1.7 MWh thermal/barrel remain explicit.
